nom: Clarins Soothing Gentle Foaming Face Cleanser

avis.texte: Very gentle and refreshing. It cleanses well without drying out my skin, leaving it soft, clean, and comfortable.
This cleanser is my least favorite of the Clarins cleansers. It felt like it was from the drug store. Skin doesn't feel as good as when I use the other ones. Glad I only tried it as a sample

avis.titre: Ok cleanser, but very gentle on sensitive skin
avis.texte: I got a 1oz sample as a gift with purchase and I've tried it a few times but it's not really good for my skin. It's very gentle and my sensitive and typically very reactive skin didn't react to it at all which is great, but it didn't get deep enough for me so I did get a few blackheads and very small whiteheads after a couple days of using this. Nothing awful, but nothing great either. I have combo dry and lightly oily skin and it's usually very reactive to any new product but it didn't react at all to this, so I'm very impressed with Clarins so far. But I think I'll try the hydrating cleanser next as a step up from this one to get my pores cleaned a bit deeper.

avis.titre: My 10 Year Holy Grail for Dry Skin
avis.texte: As a dedicated Clarins Girl for most of my life, this cleanser is the one product I absolutely cannot live without. I have incredibly dry skin, and finding a cleanser that actually helps with flakiness without stripping my skin used to be a nightmare. This formula is a total game changer. I use it twice a day, and it leaves my face feeling completely refreshed, soft, and silky smooth every single time. The texture is amazing, and a very small, pea sized amount goes a remarkably long way. It lathers beautifully, making the tube last forever and giving you incredible value for your money. If you struggle with dry, flaky skin and want a daily cleanser that actually delivers on its promises, look no further!
This product left my face greasy by midday. I think their other cleansers have better formulas. The texture of this cleanser is very nice though.

avis.titre: Breakouts and Poor Cleansing — Not Worth It
avis.texte: I'm really disappointed with this cleanser from Clarins. I had high expectations because of the brand, but after using it, my skin actually got worse. It didn't clean my face properly and left it feeling like there was still residue. On top of that, I started breaking out with acne, which I normally don't struggle with. For a product at this price point, I expected much better results. Unfortunately, it did the opposite of what it's supposed to do. I would not recommend this to anyone with sensitive or acne-prone skin.

There's some important history behind the reviews for the Soothing Gentle Foaming Face Cleanser. Clarins has been known for its cleansers for decades. Many longtime customers were deeply attached to the original formulas, especially the beloved Cottonseed cleanser from the 90s and early 2000s. In 2021, Clarins reformulated its cleanser range to prioritize sustainability and skin microbiome support. While the ingredient philosophy improved, the texture became firmer, the foaming action was minimal, fragrances changed, and even the packaging colors shifted. That understandably caused confusion and frustration among loyal users. In 2023–2024, Clarins reformulated again. This newer version is noticeably softer and creamier, with improved but still gentle foaming. It feels much closer to the pre-2021 experience while maintaining the more skin-barrier-friendly, microbiome-conscious approach. A lot of the negative reviews online reflect reactions to the 2021 version, or nostalgia for formulas from decades ago, rather than the current product on shelves. The current formula is genuinely lovely. It's delicately scented, lightly foaming, soft and creamy in texture, and it cleanses thoroughly without stripping the skin. It feels like a thoughtful evolution rather than a downgrade. If you loved the older yellow shea butter cleanser, this is a very strong modern replacement just with a more skin-barrier-conscious philosophy behind it.
A little goes a long way! This is a great face wash for someone with dry sensitive skin! I can't live without it but one large tube can last me up to six months! I don't use anything else now.
Wonderful cleanser. I have used it over 20 years and it leaves my face moist
My last purchase Face cleanser became more gentle but after 3 -4 min should apple cream.
Very mild. Sweet smelling. It's super non-irritating. Thick formulation. A staple of my skincare.

My favorite cleanser! While I was initially unhappy that Clarins got rid of the previous gentle foaming cleanser with shea butter (in the yellow), this is a wonderful replacement that cleanses, softens, and nourishes without stripping skin. The scent is light and beautiful, and it creates a creamy mouse foam when you add water. All the negative reviews are from a previous version that has since been replaced with this creamy version.
I absolutely love this cleanser. I have dry skin and it makes my face feel soft, smooth and moisturized. It also smells great! Highly recommend!!!

I've used Clarins for 30 years and sadly have had to find a replacement product. Why change a formula when it was amazing. You've kept my skin looking 10-15 years younger than my actual age for decades, and now we need to divorce.
Seems to be moisture rich and cleans well. Doesn't leave me greasy but hydrated. Smells nice too. Very light scent.

avis.titre: I don't care for the fragrance.
avis.texte: This is the first time I have tried this (I should have opted for a sample in a prior order to try it first). The texture is lovely, I don't like the fragrance at all. It reminds me of the liquid soap supplied at rest stops, not unpleasant but somewhat industrial.

I have used the Hydrating cleanser for years, which I love. However my mild rosacea has been flaring up, so I went to the gentle. bam! home run, that really made my face calm down, and it feels so gentle, I now love this one.
I'm glad I decided to try this, my face is soft and it does not irritate my skin, I have very sensitive skin
Omg what a wonderful feeling of cleansing your face gets with this with this fresh and creamy cleanser! Your skin feels like it's been at a 5 star spa!!

avis.auteur: Dry skin even in wet Florida
avis.texte: Clarins sadly changed the formula for their staple hydrating cleanser (the cream bottle) in the fall of 2024. I used the old formula for years and adored it…the new formula is drying and my skin squeaked when washing off. I went to Bloomingdales to talk to the clarins rep and she confirm it had changed. She recommended this gentle version (pink bottle) and I was immediately sold. It's fantastic!
Works well but for whatever reason the sample I received was much stronger. Just meant I had different expectation going in. In its own though, it does the job.
I love how smooth this feels as I'm washing my face. I always look forward to using it believe it or not.

This cleanser is so amazing. It doesn't strip my skin and leaves my face hydrated but clean. I received a bunch of Clarins skincare for Christmas and I am enjoying the trying out the line. The Soothing Gentle Foaming Face Cleanser has replaced the other cleansers in my routine. I would recommend it for anyone with dry, sensitive skin. So hydrating.

avis.titre: Best face wash I've come across!
avis.texte: No words for my thirsty dehydrated skin! I've always used dermatologist /cosmetic surgeons prescriptions skin care and it was stripping my skin. The scent is unbeatable. This formula has brought my skin back to life. Buy it.
I love the creamy texture, and it does not dry out my already dry skin.
Best cleanser! Never drying. Removes eye makeup. Excellent for sensitive, aging skin.

I'm new to cleansers. Up until a few months ago, I had only ever used soap to clean my face. I switched to a popular cleanser also by a popular French brand and was ok with it..because I had nothing to compare it to. I ran out and decided to try something different. I ordered the Soothing Foaming cleanser by Clarins. I tried it for the first time this morning and was blown away! It was so creamy and felt so good on my face. A little goes a long way! This bottle will definitely last me at least a year compared to the other cleanser that lasted me about 5 months. Clarins never disappoints!
